courses.title: ToolTest 1 - Gumball
courses.objective: Use the on-model Gumball for direct move, plane move, rotate and scale, then compare with numeric editing.

steps.title: Create and select a reference body
steps.learn: Create and select a reference body
steps.instructions: Create a clearly asymmetric body and select it.
steps.expectedResult: The body is selected and its orientation is obvious.

checkpoint.expected: The body is selected and its orientation is obvious.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Enable Gumball
steps.instructions: Turn on the Gumball.

checkpoint.expected: On-model direct-edit handles appear.

validationChecks: Gumball is visible for the active selection
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

validationChecks: Movement is constrained to the selected axis

validationChecks: Movement stays in the selected plane

validationChecks: Rotation occurs about the intended axis
